component_rules: Represent optional document refresh once through DocumentRefresher in the application layer.
Keep LibreOffice executable discovery in one cross-platform resolver.
Keep process startup, UNO connection, update, save and cleanup in one isolated runner.
Reuse DOCX field helpers instead of creating a second TOC field implementation.
Reuse package validation and atomic output services after refresh.
Do not add Office-specific branches to CLI, Web, Tauri or DOCX Renderer.
